zero in: direct all your attention towards a particular person or thing
typical: zero in on sb/sth. NOT for: ignoring.
She zeroed in on the weak point in his argument.
The report zeroes in on costs.
aim a weapon exactly at a target
typical: zero in on sth. NOT for: missing.
The gun zeroed in on the target.
He zeroed in on the camp.
zip up: typical: zip sth/sb up. NOT for: unzipping.
He was zipping up a small brown suitcase.
Could you zip me up, please?
zone out: stop paying attention because you are bored or tired (informal)
typical: zone out. NOT for: focusing.
Sorry, I was just zoning out there.
He zoned out in the lecture.
zoom in: make the person or thing in a picture look closer and bigger (a camera)
typical: zoom in (on sb/sth). NOT for: zooming out.
The camera zoomed in on the child's face.
start to examine something in more detail
typical: zoom in on sth. NOT for: looking broadly.
Let's zoom in on the data.
The report zooms in on one issue.
zoom out: make the person or thing in a picture look further away and smaller (a camera)
typical: zoom out. NOT for: zooming in.
The camera zoomed out to show the crowd.
Zoom out to see the whole map.
look at something in a broader way
typical: zoom out (and think). NOT for: focusing on details.
Zoom out and look at the big picture.
Let's zoom out for a moment.
